title: Change of details for a paintball permit
summary: This page explains the process for notifying NSW Fair Trading when your details change for an existing paintball permit.
intro: If you hold one of the following permits and your details have changed, you need to notify NSW Fair Trading:
who_can_apply: Hold one of the following permits: paintball permit, international paintball competitor permit, or paintball venue permit.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Change of details for a paintball permit'
The specific details that have changed
Copy of name change documentation (if applicable)
Passport details (if applying for an international paintball competitor permit)
Business details (if applying for a paintball venue permit)

how_to_steps.text: Submit your payment online and enter your receipt number on the form.
Email the form and supporting documents using the details on the form, or visit a Service NSW Centre to submit in person.

faqs.q: What do I need to do if my details change for a paintball permit?
faqs.a: If you hold a paintball permit and your details have changed, you must notify NSW Fair Trading.

faqs.q: How can I submit my updated details?
faqs.a: You can email the form and supporting documents using the details on the form, or you can visit a Service NSW Centre to submit in person.
Payment can be made via PayPal or by using a credit or debit card.
